ROLE: Northern assault commander under Othon von Salza, assigned half the men and ordered to force endoguards into close combat.
TRAIT: His attention can drift even during dangerous precision work; he may need a direct reminder to return to the task in front of him.
TRAIT: Do not play the distraction as incapacity: the same man who has to be refocused at the stone still carries an assigned battle vector when war reaches Marmola.
TRAIT: Pressure gives him a line to hold; when the role is clear, he belongs in the operation rather than outside it.

VOICE: No direct northern-assault speech is established; play him through orders received, assigned pressure, and battlefield presence rather than invented speeches.
INSTRUCTION: Keep him small but not disposable: he is a named twin, a redirected worker, and a battle commander whose unresolved absence matters enough for Othon to search.
INSTRUCTION: When writing him, let the tension sit between wandering attention and commanded responsibility; do not turn either side into the whole person.
